text:
maria: Hey team—AirFrame's CI started failing overnight. Their nightly job that computes embeddings for search now returns a 403 only for /v1/embeddings while text generation still works. They say nothing changed on their side.

alex_airframe: Confirmed — all embedding calls in our pipeline started failing at 02:14 UTC. Chat endpoints are fine. We tried rotating the key and still 403. Error body: "code=insufficient_permissions; missing_scope=embeddings"

maria: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the curl you ran? Also which key id?

alex_airframe: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-1","input":"foo"}'

alex_airframe: Key id reported in UI: key_ak_1792. Nightly pipeline uses service principal that was provisioned by their infra team.

ajay: I'll triage. Maria, can you share the internal key ID mapping (we store external->internal) and any recent lifecycle events (rotate/reprovision)?

maria: internal id is svc-key-79a. Our audit shows a provisioning event at 2026-03-16T23:58Z by the provisioning service. No manual rotates.

tom: Quick check — looks like the token claims on svc-key-79a only include ["inference:generate"] and not the embeddings/rerank scopes. That would explain the 403 message.

ajay: Hmm, provisioning service should add both inference and embeddings for service principals by default. Could be a new default profile change or a CSV truncation on scope list.

maria: Customer insists nothing changed on their side. Is there an easy introspect they can run to confirm scopes?

ajay: Yes — run the key introspect endpoint from their CI:

  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/introspect \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"key":"sk_live_XXXX"}'

The response includes a scopes array. If embeddings missing, that's the root cause.

alex_airframe: Ran the introspect and got back: {"active":true,"scopes":["inference:generate"],"created_at":"2026-03-16T23:58:10Z"}

tom: Confirms it. Okay — short-term fix: create a replacement scoped key with embeddings + inference and update the CI secret. I can create a temp key with limited lifetime and give it to Alex.

alex_airframe: That would unblock us. How did this happen? Their provisioning service calls our SCIM-based endpoint to create keys and pass a scope CSV. We saw the CSV field had trailing whitespace earlier but thought it was harmless.

ajay: Trailing whitespace shouldn't drop scopes normally, but we recently changed the provisioner parsing library (lib-svc-provision v2.4.0) to split on semicolons instead of commas for legacy reasons. If the customer's infra still emits comma-separated scopes, parsing could have picked only the first token.

maria: Is there a migration we missed? Any customers impacted beyond AirFrame?

tom: I'll run a query for provisioning events in the last 48h where the parser version is v2.4.0 and the resulting scope list length < 2. If many, we'll need a rollout/status page note.

ajay: Action items:
- tom: query and list impacted keys + contact owners (ETA 1h)
- maria: generate a short-lived embeddings+infer key for AirFrame and post to their secure ticket (ETA 10m)
- ajay: quick rollback or patch for the parser (ETA 3h)

deploy-bot: Deployment started: lib-svc-provision v2.4.0 -> infra-provisioner (canary) at 2026-03-16T21:05:12Z :rocket:

maria: Deploy-bot timestamp matches. Alex, I'll DM the temp key and instructions for swapping env var in their CI. Please rotate after you confirm success.

alex_airframe: Got the temp key and swapped it in. Nightly run kicked off at 03:02 UTC and embeddings job passed. Thank you.

tom: Query results: 6 keys provisioned with v2.4.0 and reduced scope sets in the last 24h. I've opened a list in the incident doc and pinged owners.

ajay: We'll roll back the canary to v2.3.9 and push a patch that accepts both comma and semicolon separators. Also adding an automated check in provisioner that validates a minimal required scope set for service principals.

maria: Noted. I'll update the ticket with root cause (provisioner parsing change) and mitigation steps. We'll leave this thread open until rollback and contacts are complete. :white_check_mark:

alex_airframe: Appreciate the quick help — please loop us on the timeline for the permanent fix so we can plan our infra changes.

ajay: Will do. Short-term: temp key -> done. Medium: rollback + patch. Long-term: add a warning and hard validation in the provisioner.

maria: Closing the customer-facing ticket after we confirm owners contacted. Internal incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/CI-embeds-provisioner-2387654321

tom: Rollback scheduled for canary at 2026-03-17T01:45Z. I'll post updates.

maria: thanks team.
